other_conditions: The marriage must be registered under the Special Marriage Act, 1954.
The applicant’s marriage must be solemnised on or after 1 December 2019 and registered on or after 1 January 2020.
The applicant girl must apply for the benefit on the same day she applies for marriage registration.
The benefit is available only for the applicant’s first marriage.
Both bride and groom must have passed at least HSLC or equivalent, except members of Tea Tribe and Adivasi communities who are exempt from this educational requirement.
Eligibility category noted in source: Tea Tribe
Eligibility category noted in source: Adivasi
benefits_summary: A one‑time cash incentive of ₹40,000 is transferred to the bride’s account for purchasing gold, and it must be used only for that purpose.
documents_required: Physical application form submitted with the marriage application
Online application form (printout) with signed declaration
